Name: (BAGI) Honey and Mead Icons for Trees - Cometkins' Style
Author: Zyrnathos
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/505AIXP.png[/img]
[/center]
Are you using all four of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Good Icons[/url]﻿ (plus [url=https://github.com/daleao/bagi-meads]the mead add-on[/url]), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Beehouses[/url] (or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13780] Fruit Tree Honey[/url]) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Mead[/url]? Me too! I mean, it only makes sense, right? How are fruit trees supposed to bear fruits without first sprouting flowers? It logically follows that bees should be able to produce honey from them (which is the case IRL), and we, the farmers, the respective meads.

Anyway, after judging the chance of someone to 1) use all the mentioned mods, 2) be willing to make a BAGI pack and 3) in Cometkins' gorgeous style to be abysmal, I took it upon myself to do just that. Thus came forth this poorly recoloured, tragic excuse of a BAGI pack.

[b]A few notes...
[spoiler][/b]
[size=2]*sorry for the messy format. I'm done trying to fight Nexus.*﻿[/size]
[list]
[*]The lids and bottle caps(?) of honeys and meads respectively were recoloured to a natural shade (I hope) of dark green due to the following reasons:
[/list][list=1]
[*]To differentiate them from their typical floral counterparts. Why? Variety is the spice of life!
[*]I like the colour.
[*]I can.
[/list][list]
[*]There are some slightly arbitrary deviations in the label's colours:
[/list][list=1]
[*]the lighter green for when the label blends too well with the background
[*]the original light brown for flowering trees (e.g., fragrant wisteria) to denote their hybrid nature (being both "actual (gameplay-wise)" flowers and trees ﻿at the same time).
[/list][list]
[*]I tried my best to select the most accurate colour for each tree based on either its produce's 1) IRL appearance, or 2) in-game depiction (by Cometkins for Vanillia and the PPJA team for More trees), whichever appeals more to me. I apologise if some look a bit off. [spoiler] For instance, I personally haven't seen a mango with such a deep shade of orange as that in Better Artisan Goods, so I opted instead for a mix of yellow-orange tone (which unfortunately is a significant contrast to other mango products).[/spoiler][/spoiler]
[/list]
[center][color=#d9d2e9]**I acknowledge the low quality of the sprites as my pixel art skill leaves much to be desired. Therefore, more artistically inclined people are more than welcome and[b] [u]strongly encouraged[/u][/b] to make their own pack(s). I'll most likely hide mine should that be the case (hence the "placeholder" in the title)**[/color][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/6FNMsP3.png[/img]﻿ 
﻿[/center][b][size=4][color=#ffff00]**IMPORTANT**[/color] [/size][/b][b][color=#c27ba0][size=3]CHECK! THE! REQUIREMENTS![/size][/color][/b]

This mod is but a BAGI content pack and [u]does nothing on its own[/u]. You'll need most of the mods listed above to get it working.

Please follow these steps to ensure smooth usage:
[list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url] and its [url=https://github.com/daleao/bagi-meads]mead add-on[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Beehouse[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13780]Fruit Tree Honey[/url] (choose one, NOT both!) along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Mead[/url].

[*]Download this mod.

[*]Extract all into your Stardew mod folder. By default, it should be [i]C:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]
[*][color=#93c47d][Extra][/color] Not actually required, but I highly recommend you download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿ as well for a matching set of all artisan goods. 
[/list][center][/center][center]
[b][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/aJWbekg.png[/img]
[/size][/b][/center][b][size=3]
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Every author of the required mods, without which my dream of a fruit tree grove-apiary would never, ahem, bear fruit. ;)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38715215]Cometkins[/url]﻿ for the original sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/79665293]Doragoun[/url]﻿ as their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14388]BAGI[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14290]packs[/url]﻿ inspired me to create this﻿
[/list]
